Adjusted R² = 1 - (1 - R²)(n - 1)/(n - k - 1), n = rows used, k = number of predictors (cSEM Estimates$R2adj). Defined for endogenous constructs only.

matrices.title: Heterotrait–monotrait ratio (HTMT)
matrices.definition: HTMT (Henseler, Ringle & Sarstedt, 2015): mean absolute heterotrait correlation / sqrt(product of the mean absolute monotrait correlations), on Pearson indicator correlations (cSEM assess(), .absolute = TRUE). Reflective constructs with at least 2 indicators only; other constructs are omitted (not applicable). Diagonal is null (not applicable).

matrices.title: HTMT2 (geometric-mean HTMT)
matrices.definition: HTMT2 (Roemer, Schuberth & Henseler, 2021): as HTMT with geometric instead of arithmetic means, on Pearson indicator correlations (cSEM assess(), .absolute = TRUE). Reflective constructs with at least 2 indicators only; other constructs are omitted (not applicable). Diagonal is null (not applicable).

matrices.title: Fornell–Larcker criterion
matrices.definition: Fornell–Larcker matrix (cSEM assess() fl_criterion): diagonal = AVE, off-diagonal = squared construct correlations. Reflective constructs with at least 2 indicators only.

matrices.title: Cross-loadings
matrices.definition: Pearson correlation of each indicator with each construct score (cSEM Estimates$Construct_scores, standardized composites).

matrices.title: Construct correlations
matrices.definition: Construct correlations (cSEM Estimates$Construct_VCV): correlations of the standardized composites (classic PLS, no consistency correction).

matrices.title: Effect size f²
matrices.definition: f² = (R²_incl - R²_excl) / (1 - R²_incl) per structural path (row = predictor, column = endogenous construct), cSEM definition (assess() F2): R²_excl drops the predictor from the regression on the SAME construct correlations; the model is not re-estimated. Null where there is no path.

matrices.title: Structural VIF
matrices.definition: Variance inflation factor of each predictor in the regression of the endogenous construct (row = predictor, column = endogenous construct): diagonal of the inverse predictor correlation matrix (cSEM Estimates$VIF). Equals 1 by definition for a single predictor. Null where there is no path.

matrices.title: Indicator VIF (Mode B blocks)
matrices.definition: Indicator VIF within each Mode B block: diagonal of the inverse indicator correlation matrix of the block (cSEM assess() VIF_modeB). Rows = indicators of Mode B blocks, columns = Mode B constructs; null outside the indicator's own block and for single-indicator blocks.

fit.name: srmr
fit.definition: Standardized root mean square residual: sqrt(mean of the squared differences between the empirical and the model-implied indicator correlations over the lower triangle INCLUDING the diagonal) (cSEM assess() SRMR, model-implied matrix from cSEM::fit()). No CB-SEM cutoffs apply.

fit.name: d_uls
fit.definition: Unweighted least-squares discrepancy d_ULS = 0.5 · Σ_ij (s_ij - σ̂_ij)² over all elements of the empirical (S) and model-implied (Σ̂) indicator correlation matrices (cSEM assess() DL). No CB-SEM cutoffs apply.

fit.name: d_g
fit.definition: Geodesic discrepancy d_G = 0.5 · Σ_i (log10 λ_i)², λ_i the eigenvalues of S⁻¹Σ̂ — cSEM uses the BASE-10 logarithm; the natural-log definition is (ln 10)² ≈ 5.30 times larger (cSEM assess() DG). No CB-SEM cutoffs apply.

ipma.convention: Each indicator is first reverse scored where flagged ((min + max) - x), then rescaled to 0-100 as (x - min)/(max - min)*100 with its declared original scale endpoints (never the observed minimum/maximum). Classic PLS-SEM (no consistency correction; same inner weighting scheme, iteration cap and tolerance as the main fit) is re-estimated on the rescaled data. Unstandardized outer weights = standardized weight / sd(rescaled indicator), normalized to sum to 1 within each block; construct score = weighted sum of the rescaled indicators (0-100 when no weight is negative). Performance = mean construct score (constructs) or mean rescaled indicator (indicators), on the 0-100 scale. Importance = unstandardized total effect of the construct on the target: OLS of each endogenous score on its predictors' scores gives B, total effects = (I - B)^-1 - I. Indicator importance = normalized weight x the construct's importance. Negative importance keeps its sign. Constructs listed are all predecessors of the target (any directed path); 'direct' means a direct structural path exists. Point estimates only (no bootstrap intervals).

warnings.message: IPMA importance and performance are point estimates in this version (no bootstrap intervals).

provenance.call:
model <- "C1 =~ X1 + X2 + X3
C2 =~ X4 + X5 + X6
C3 =~ X7 + X8
C4 =~ X9 + X10 + X11
C5 =~ X12
C2 ~ C1
C3 ~ C1 + C2
C4 ~ C1 + C2 + C3
C5 ~ C4"
fit <- cSEM::csem(.data = data, .model = model, .approach_weights = "PLS-PM", .approach_paths = "OLS", .disattenuate = FALSE, .PLS_weight_scheme_inner = "path", .iter_max = 300L, .tolerance = 1e-07, .conv_criterion = "diff_absolute")
fit_rhoA <- cSEM::csem(.data = data, .model = model, .approach_weights = "PLS-PM", .approach_paths = "OLS", .disattenuate = TRUE, .PLS_weight_scheme_inner = "path", .iter_max = 300L, .tolerance = 1e-07, .conv_criterion = "diff_absolute", .PLS_approach_cf = "dist_squared_euclid")
for (k in 0:9) cSEM::resamplecSEMResults(.object = fit, .resample_method = "bootstrap", .R = min(100, 1000 - 100 * k), .seed = (20150101 + k) %% 2147483647, .handle_inadmissibles = "drop", .sign_change_option = "none", .eval_plan = "sequential")
fit_ipma <- cSEM::csem(.data = data_rescaled_0_100, .model = model, .approach_weights = "PLS-PM", .approach_paths = "OLS", .disattenuate = FALSE, .PLS_weight_scheme_inner = "path", .iter_max = 300L, .tolerance = 1e-07, .conv_criterion = "diff_absolute")
